review.note: Retracted in M21, and the cached leads disagree about its date: English Wikipedia says 6 December 1919, Portuguese Wikipedia says 6 August 1919. The disagreement is worth keeping — it is exactly the kind of thing review.html exists for — but it is not an argument, and no consequence of this election can be argued from the bibliography here. It elected the one president of the First Republic to serve a full term, 1919 to 1923.
